title: Deployment of Surveillance Cameras to Catch High-rise Littering and Trial of Other Technologies to Supplement Present Efforts
what_it_is: Deployment of Surveillance Cameras to Catch High-rise Littering and Trial of Other Technologies to Supplement Present Efforts

sections.label: High-rise littering feedback reports
sections.summary: In 2022 and 2023, NEA received an average of about 27,100 high-rise littering feedback reports per year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In 2022 and 2023, NEA received an average of about 27,100 high-rise littering feedback reports per year.

sections.label: Surveillance camera deployment in littering cases
sections.summary: Between 2021 and 2023, NEA deployed cameras in about 97.1% of 7,400 persistent high-rise littering cases, with the remainder assessed as unsuitable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Between 2021 and 2023, NEA deployed cameras in about 97.1% of 7,400 persistent high-rise littering cases.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The remainder were assessed as unsuitable, due to the design and layout of the blocks and the lack of appropriate vantage points.

sections.label: Detection and enforcement actions
sections.summary: From 2021 to 2023, such acts were detected in about 30% of surveillance camera deployments, resulting in over 3,300 enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: From 2021 to 2023, such acts were detected in about 30% of surveillance cameras deployment resulting in over 3,300 enforcement actions.

sections.label: Monitoring detection and enforcement measures
sections.summary: The Ministry will continue to monitor and explore measures to enhance detection and enforcement capabilities for high-rise littering, including video analytics, artificial intelligence and drone flights.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: My Ministry will continue to monitor and explore measures to enhance detection and enforcement capabilities for high-rise littering, including keeping pace with technological developments in video analytics and artificial intelligence, and monitoring the suitability and safety of technologies, such as drone flights for high-rise littering surveillance.

sections.label: Data analytics for camera deployment
sections.summary: Processes for surveillance camera deployment have been improved, now using data analytics to prioritise hot spots with persistent and egregious high-rise littering.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Over the years we have improved or enhanced our processes in terms of surveillance camera deployment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Now we use data analytics to prioritise deployment of surveillance cameras.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: If there are hot spots with persistent littering and egregious high-rise littering acts, these will be prioritised for deployment of surveillance cameras.

sections.label: Penalties for high-rise littering
sections.summary: Since 2014 maximum court fines have doubled, with high-rise littering penalties up to $2,000, $4,000 and $10,000, and possible Corrective Work Order.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regard to the third question from the Member Ms Yeo on penalties, since 2014, we have doubled the maximum court fines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For high-rise littering, they are not offered composition fine.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And the maximum penalty, as I have said, has been doubled: first offence, up to $2,000; second offence, up to $4,000; third and subsequent offence, up to $10,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: When high-rise litterbugs are caught on surveillance cameras, they may be caught for more than one act, because the surveillance cameras can be there for five days, seven days and up to 14 days.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have seen cases where they are caught every day for high-rise littering and so, the fine, the penalty is very stiff and they can also be asked to go for Corrective Work Order.

sections.label: High-rise littering enforcement frustration
sections.summary: A Member reinforces residents' frustration over high-rise littering, noting the Senior Minister of State said enforcement success is only 30% even in egregious cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: I would not repeat the same points my colleagues have already made, but I just wanted to reinforce that the frustration for high-rise littering remains a very significant one amongst my residents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Foo Mee Har (West Coast)
sentences.text: I noted that the Senior Minister of State mentioned that for even very egregious cases where there are a lot of reports, the success rate for enforcement is only 30%.

sections.label: Overall catch rate varies
sections.summary: The 30% catch rate is overall and varies from year to year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The 30% catch rate is overall and it varies from year to year.

sections.label: Aiming cameras at stacks
sections.summary: Pinning down a particular stack or few levels and aiming the camera there raises the likelihood of catching high-rise littering.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: If we are able to really pin down that particular stack or that particular few levels, and we are able to aim the camera there, then the likelihood of being caught for the high-rise littering is higher.

sections.label: Dementia, mental health, caregiver distress
sections.summary: Perpetrators may have dementia or other mental health conditions, and caregivers and kin face distress from neighbours' negative perceptions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Carrie Tan (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Whether they could have dementia or they could be suffering from other mental health conditions, and it is also very distressful for the caregivers and kin living in the same household as the perpetrator to continue to continuously face the negative perceptions and experiences of neighbours who are suffering from this high-rise littering behaviour.

sections.label: Working with families on mental issues
sections.summary: In cases involving mental issues, authorities work with families, refer them for treatment, or encourage and advise the family to do so.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: When we come across cases where it is a mental issue and so on, which we have, we do work with the families, refer them for treatment or encourage or advise the family to do so.
